actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository contains Gazebo, MuJoCo and Isaac Sim simulations for a differential-drive robot equipped with an IMU, a depth camera, a stereo camera and a 2D LiDAR.
The MuJoCo launch starts the robot in the MuJoCo warehouse and enables wheel control, odometry, IMU, 2D LiDAR, the depth camera and stereo cameras.
The MuJoCo ROS 2 control xacro declares the MujocoSystem hardware plugin mujoco_ros2_control/MujocoSystemInterface and sets its mujoco_model parameter to $(find bcr_bot)/mjcf/small_warehouse.xml.
The configured scene is mjcf/small_warehouse.xml, an MJCF model named bcr_bot_small_warehouse that includes bcr_bot.xml.
The included bcr_bot.xml model compiles angles in radians, points meshdir and texturedir at ../meshes, and sets option timestep 0.002 s with gravity 0 0 -9.81.
The robot model starts with a base_footprint body carrying a freejoint named base_footprint_joint.
The middle_left_wheel and middle_right_wheel bodies each carry a hinge joint on axis 0 1 0 and a cylinder collision geom of size 0.1 0.025.
The actuator block has two velocity actuators, one for each middle wheel joint, with kv=100 and a forcerange of -20000 to 20000; neither actuator element declares a ctrlrange.
The model declares a framequat sensor, a gyro and an accelerometer at imu_site and a rangefinder at two_d_lidar_ray.
The MuJoCo launch starts the mujoco_ros2_control package's ros2_control_node with config/mujoco_controllers.yaml as its parameter file.
The MuJoCo launch starts the twist_stamper package's twist_stamper as bcr_bot_twist_stamper with cmd_vel_in remapped to /bcr_bot/cmd_vel and cmd_vel_out to /bcr_bot/cmd_vel_stamped.
The diff_drive_controller configuration names the two middle wheel joints and sets wheel_separation 0.64, wheel_radius 0.11, publish_rate 30.0 and cmd_vel_timeout 0.5.
CMakeLists.txt installs the launch, meshes, models, urdf, worlds, rviz, config and mjcf directories into the package share.
The empty_world.xml scene declares the model bcr_bot_empty_world and includes bcr_bot.xml.

determinism.notes: Event-driven placeholder integration with no contact, constraint or force solver; the same control input reproduces the same placeholder state hash, but this is a stand-in digest, not a MuJoCo trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a package-local stand-in for the mujoco module: it parses the MJCF and its includes for model shape, actuator names and option timestep, but it does not load meshes, textures, inertias or contacts and runs no MuJoCo physics
each velocity actuator is modelled as a placeholder joint-velocity command; the two wheel hinges turn, but the free base, gravity, contacts, friction and the model's force limits are not integrated
the snapshot uses the bridge's basic profile (time, qpos, qvel, act and ctrl) because the stand-in exposes no full integration-state API; warm-start and derived quantities are not preserved
the published timestep_ms is read from the model's option element, but the fake's state advance is a placeholder and does not establish MuJoCo timing or determinism
the upstream ROS 2 control graph, sensor streams, camera rendering, Nav2 and SLAM are NOT COVERED

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

operator_required.name: step
operator_required.reason: the model gives none of its actuators no control range (ctrllimited false or no ctrlrange), so MuJoCo leaves the control unclamped; site-limits.json must bound action.ctrl before a step can set it

safe_state.description: The simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no cap.world.step.v1 or cap.world.reset.v1 call is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the integration state stays readable.
